text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky succeeded brilliantly in 
achieving great results in the Twinkle 
Series.

Having drawn attention even before her 
debut, she delivered a performance that 
far exceeded even those high expectations—
And so, one day.
(VROOM VRRRROOOOOM!! Skrrrrt)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waitin', Trainer-kun! Come on, 
hop on, hop on!
choice_data_list: So, where are we going today...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waitin', Trainer-chan! Come on, 
hop on, hop on!
choice_data_list: So, where are we going today...?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"That's true~... We went to the beach last 
time, so maybe the mountains would be nice 
this time!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I mean, why are you so terrified anyway?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I told you, it's A-OK! I always follow 
the traffic rules, don't I?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
She can be a bit wild at times, but 
Tacchan's just at that age where she wants 
to horse around!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"We're here~! Speeding down the road with 
Tac-chan is the absolute best after all!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, shall we get started with 
training?
choice_data_list:
Why've you been training out on the go 
lately?

Why have you been training while you're 
out lately?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Isn't that obvious?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I do want to go for a drive, but I also 
want to train!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Happily, we've gained so many rivals, and 
the best races are all lined up ahead of 
us, right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm just itching to run as much as I 
possibly can!
choice_data_list:
I can really feel how much fun you're 
having!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! I'll keep on showing everyone a back 
worth looking up to!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And not just my rivals, Trainer-kun, you 
too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And not just my rivals, Trainer-chan, you 
too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I have to make you want to be my Trainer 
forever and ever!
choice_data_list:
I'll do my very best to live up to 
expectations too!

I'll do my absolute best to respond in 
kind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's both have an absolute blast!
